title: Nebius reports second quarter 2026 financial results
publisher: Nebius Group N.V. via the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
excerpt: Q2 revenue was USD 582.3 million, adjusted EBITDA was USD 236.2 million, and purchases of property, equipment and intangible assets were USD 5.6574 billion.
summary: The SEC-filed issuer release reports exceptional Q2 growth and positive adjusted EBITDA, but capital purchases exceeded operating cash flow, share-based compensation rose, debt exceeded cash, and 271,855,218 shares were issued and outstanding at June 30.
